# Synthetic M1 reader fixtures

Generated by `tools/build_m1_fixtures.py`; no public/private-test records or
answers are included. `cp1258.csv` exercises Vietnamese base vowels;
`utf8_sig.csv` and `utf16.csv` exercise Unicode BOMs and semicolon dialect; `blocks.xlsx` contains a
sparse merged header, multiple blocks, total and trailing-note rows;
`wal.sqlite` is checkpointed in WAL mode and contains a table and a view.
Live-WAL, uncached-formula, ambiguous-date, number, token-budget and failure
isolation cases are constructed independently in `tests/m1/` and
`tests/preprocessing/`.
